result.title: CtrlWAM: Controllable World Action Models with Aligned Intent and Foresight
result.summary: World action models (WAMs) jointly predict actions (intent) and visual future (foresight). Standard training adds noise to recorded actions and video simultaneously, but such training paradigms introduce a mismatch: perturbed actions imply counterfactual future visual, while the noised video remains tied to the GT recording. In low-noise regime, the scene geometry and even the dynamic behavior remain clearly visible from the noisy future frames despite the added noise. We present CtrlWAM, which executes perturbed actions in a simulator and pairs them with their noised visual consequences for joint WAM learning. To accommodate the different denoising requirements of video and actions, we introduce warped video--action noise schedules that aim to keep visual layout responsive as action predictions evolve. We further extend the action interface from ego-only control to a variable number of agent streams, allowing a unified model to represent predicted or commanded futures for multiple agents. Driving experiments show more accurate action forecasts, closer agreement between generated video and actions, and better following of supplied commands; robotics experiments show stronger motion fidelity and controllability. Matched controls support the benefit of off-path renders for command following and manipulation fidelity. Together, these findings contribute to a more controllable world action model. Project page: https://ctrl-wam.github.io/

AI.brief_summary: CtrlWAM 面向「世界动作模型」，通过将扰动动作在模拟器中执行以生成对应的未来视觉后果，并设计视频–动作联合噪声调度与多智能体动作接口，提升动作预测与可控性。
AI.relevance_reason: 属于世界模型/机器人控制与视频预测方向，关注的是动作与视觉未来对齐的可控生成，未涉及 VLM 内部 latent 推理状态、证据筛选或停止决策，也无可直接迁移到 LVR 的状态或监督线索。
